title: Watering
description: Learn the right watering schedule for your plants

title: Sunlight
description: Match your plant to your lighting needs
tips: Place plants in bright, indirect light for most houseplants
Rotate plants regularly for even growth
Avoid direct harsh sunlight for sensitive leaves
Use grow lights if natural light is insufficient

title: Humidity
description: Keep tropical plants happy with proper humidity
tips: Group plants together to increase humidity
Use a pebble tray with water
Consider a humidifier in dry environments

title: Fertilizing
description: Feed your plants the right way
tips: Fertilize monthly during spring and summer
Reduce or stop fertilizing in fall and winter
Use balanced, water-soluble fertilizer for indoor plants
Follow package instructions to avoid overfeeding
